title: Fabricator
move_pattern: Alternates each turn between spawning minions or dealing damage based on its current army size. While it has fewer than 4 alive teammates, it randomly uses Fabricate (spawns both defensive and aggro bots) or Fabricating Strike (deals damage and spawns aggro bot). Once it reaches 4 teammates, it switches to Disintegrate (damage only) and cannot spawn more minions.
notes: Fabricator summons minions to fight alongside it. It maintains two bot pools: defensive (Guardbot, Noisebot) and aggro (Zapbot, Stabbot). The same bot type is never spawned twice in a row—it alternates between options. Fabricator has a spawn cap of 4 alive minions; once reached, it stops spawning and uses Disintegrate until minions die. Minions inherit the Minion Power status. FABRICATING_STRIKE_MOVE is hidden from the Bestiary.
